poema.texto:
silencio
                tengo tu ausencia 
                         como un hueso
                           roto 
                         sin conexión



                                nuevas 
                 personas en 
  mi vida sin 
               tuyo rostro 
                 en el marco

                                                                                      
                                                 un nudo
               tiras
                 desconexión
       tomadas al 
                 desamor 
                                                                                           
                               solitario



                                         un caleidoscopio
                       roto en pieces 
                                                         
                         sin ritmo 
                                                             
                                 ni melodía 



                 escribo
                 tu nombre a 
                               manana 

                                sin fechas
